title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode7 Decision

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, nobody wants to see the real me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm willing to bet there are plenty of people out there who would support you for who you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Support me for who I am...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Try taking a look around.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll find them.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luka was kind to say so, but who would want to support me as I am now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, you here...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not coming to practice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. If your head's elsewhere, there's not much point in practicing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I stopped by to see if you wanted to walk home together. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. Thank you...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It feels like it's been forever since it was just the two of us like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We're usually all together after finishing practice so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you figured out what you want to do...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been thinking about which version of you to show to everyone, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still not sure...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't want to keep MORE MORE JUMP! from doing the things everyone else wants to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But when I think about the fans who support me, I also don't want to ruin their image of me from my time in Cheerful*Days...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The fans who support you, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm willing to bet there are fans out there who would be happy to support you for who you are now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But... I can't imagine anyone who would want to do that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can. And they're closer than you think too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I think you might know one of them.
Her name is Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She loves both the Shizuku from Cheerful*Days and the Shizuku she's gotten to know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should've seen how passionate she was when she started talking about how much she wants your fans to know just how amazing you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori said that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know you might think your everyday self lacks appeal...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But personally, I like you just the way you are, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How do I put it into words? You remind me of a swan...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A swan?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, have you ever heard how a swan swims? It looks like they're gracefully gliding across the water, but they're actually paddling like crazy with their feet underneath.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think that describes you pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your singing and dancing are perfect, and you always light up the stage with your smile. But behind the scenes, you work harder than anyone else I know.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
That's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There are plenty of other great things about you too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You always look like you have it together but can be an airhead sometimes, which helps lighten everyone's mood.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or like how you're terrible at directions, but you always enjoy going for walks. As much trouble as you can be at times, I just can't get myself to leave you be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Airi, you know me so well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, of course I do.
We're both a part of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm willing to bet there are plenty of people out there who would support you for who you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I finally understand. It wouldn't be right to make those who support me every day worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
I've made my decision.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wonder if Shizuku is going to miss today too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry. She's got a committee meeting today, but said she'll be here when they're finished.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Everyone...!
Sorry I'm late!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sorry for making you all wait this long.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I've finally made up my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've decided that I want everyone to see me as I am right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see... If that's what you've decided,
then I'll do everything I can to support you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay not editing any of our videos?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But would you mind if I took a couple of minutes at the end of our next livestream for myself? I'd like to explain my feelings to the fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
We'll make sure there's enough time for that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Speaking about our next stream, Minori had a suggestion about what we could do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She did?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Haruka, Airi, and I were trying to come up with the best way to show the fans how great you are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We came up with multiple ideas that we could use, no matter what your decision was in the end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We ended up staying so late the teachers asked us to leave so they could lock up. But even then, Minori kept pleading for more time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That really was a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But... I was so close to coming up with a good idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe!
That's our Minori for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You... You did all of that for me?
Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did! So you'd better give us the best version of yourself after making us wait so long!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll make sure to give the fans hope this time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
Airi Momoi from MORE MORE JUMP! here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For our third stream, we'll be doing some Brutal Dance Training!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna be learning an even harder dance routine than we did last time! And we're not stopping until we master it!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You can do it!>
<Haruka's dancing too?!>
<You can do it, Airi...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I took another look at the choreography before the stream, but this really is a tough song...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Even for you, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's going to take quite a bit of work to master this one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even so, there's nothing we can do but give it our best! Right, Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Well, Shizuku's a great dancer so...>
<I doubt Shizuku will have any trouble!>
<Good luck, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone...
We appreciate your support.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I have to see this through.
To give everyone hope!)
